media.alt: Text-led reel styled as a clipboard with a printout of K&A Performance's own Google reviews and a highlighter, with the K&A Performance logo and ka-performancefl.com at the top of every frame. Hook: Read your reviews the way your next customer does, over K&A's profile: K & A Performance, 5.0 stars, 8 reviews, Website designer. They check three things. Every review frame is labeled: Our real Google reviews, redrawn from our profile. Sept 30, 2026. Names shortened. 1, the newest review: a five-star review from S., 3 weeks ago, marked New, with the date highlighted. Is it recent? A fresh date says people still choose you. 2, did the owner reply?: a five-star review from Lisa, a month ago, with Response from the owner: Thank you so much, highlighted. A reply shows someone reads them. 3, one detail they can picture: a five-star review from Bobby, 2 months ago, with the line Within a matter of hours we had our first proposal and within days a working demo highlighted. A real detail says more than great service. Ends on: Read your own profile like a stranger. Open it in a private window. Check all three: the newest review, the owner's reply, one detail they can picture. Local search is part of every site we build. ka-performancefl.com/services/seo-ai-search. Call Alex 904-210-1071.
